name: Fujiwara no Michinobu
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 52); Porter’s note gives the dates as: 10th century.

poems.title: Although I know the gentle night
poems.author: Fujiwara no Michinobu
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 52
poems.text:
Although I know the gentle night
Will surely follow morn,
Yet, when I’m wakened by the sun,
Turn over, stretch and yawn—
How I detest the dawn!

poems.title: 52. 明けぬれば くるるものとは 知りながら (Akenureba kururu mono to wa shirinagara)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Michinobu
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 後拾遺集
poems.text:
明けぬれば くるるものとは 知りながら
なほ恨めしき 朝ぼらけかな
